questions.explanation: 'Only if' makes the condition necessary; the result follows only when it is met.

questions.explanation: 'Even if' concedes that the result holds regardless of the condition.

options: Only if you had told me

questions.explanation: With fronted 'only if', the main clause inverts: 'will we consider'.

Only if the data verified will we consider

questions.explanation: 'Only if' expresses necessity; the other linkers express concession or manner.
